svg.title: Julian Antony Lang — Co-Founder & CTO, AI-Z Group
svg.desc: Julian Antony Lang. Co-Founder and CTO at AI-Z Group and inventor of Brane AIF, the AI Interaction Firewall. Builds AI that runs on the machine in front of you and decides what is allowed to leave it. Previously CompuSafe Data Systems, Allianz Technology, and co-founder of Omega VR. Beside the text, a halftone globe turns while a satellite circles it.
